description: Makes a glaze recipe, in percent, from the materials given whose unity formula comes as near a target as they allow (Solve for a target in the Glazecalc app). The target is a unity formula (moles; the fluxes are scaled to add up to 1) or an oxide analysis (percent by weight of the fired glaze), with potash and soda apart. Give the materials by their library names, or onHand for the materials on the person’s shelf (with a token or connected app that may read it). closeness says how near each oxide comes: close (within 0.02, or 5% of a large amount such as silica’s), off, or far (more than three times that), with a verdict (close, fair or poor) and a summary; unreachable names the target’s oxides nothing given supplies. Raw clay is held to 20% of the batch where that costs the match little (capped and allowMore say more). Test any recipe before using it.

allowMore.description: Materials whose suggested cap to lift, as report.capped names them: raw clay is held to 20% of the batch (or the recipe's own share) where that costs the match little.

firing.description: The firing, as a cone or a temperature. Leave it out when it is not known. From cone 12 up (about 1320 °C) no published glaze limits reach, so the limits are not checked there; the cone check judges cone 06 to 10 only.

chart.description: Which cones the cone is: Orton (the default) or SK (JIS R 8101).

cone.description: An Orton cone from 022 to 42 ("06", "6", "10", "14", a half cone as "5.5"), or with chart "sk" an SK cone (JIS R 8101) from SK 022 to SK 20 ("6a", "8", "14").

language.description: The language for any sentences in the answer, as a BCP 47 tag such as "en", "de" or "ja". Languages Glazecalc does not offer are answered in English.

materials.description: The library names of the materials to make it from. Use search_materials to find the names.

mustUse.description: Materials given that must be in the recipe.

onHand.description: Make it from the materials on the person’s shelf, as well as any named: needs a token or connected app that may read it.

target.description: The unity formula or oxide analysis to aim for.

kind.description: "unity": moles per mole of fluxes; "analysis": percent by weight of the fired glaze.

oxides.description: Each oxide by its formula, such as { "K2O": 0.3, "CaO": 0.7, "Al2O3": 0.4, "SiO2": 3.2 }.

name: solve_target
title: Make a recipe for a target formula
